correctness.rationale: For each draw word, the event that a given coupon is present depends only on survival from its last occurrence through observation; independence across coupon types makes conditional target coverage the product of last-visit retention factors. Conditioning on the unordered positions of a pair decouples its total drawing weight and yields iid Bernoulli(a) labels. The terminal run length K satisfies P(K>=k)=a^k+(1-a)^k. The exact telescoping expansion has nonnegative coefficients summing to f(1)>0, and every k>=2 power sum strictly increases as a leaves 1/2. This proves strict finite-horizon pairwise balancing on a positive-probability event whenever t>=|A| and weights are positive. The same argument with convergent infinite tails proves the stationary case 0<q<1; an independent stationary subset recurrence checks the formula. The actual standalone checker ran with 1,188 exact Fraction assertions comparing different full-state and word-level computations, including finite-state stationary linear systems. Finite checks alone do not establish the theorem; the conditional argument does. No claims for the first-hitting law, type-dependent losses or stationary q=1.

originality.rationale: The main original claim is strict majorization optimality of prescribed-time and stationary simultaneous coverage with independent coupon-wise losses and unequal draw probabilities, including any common time-dependent survival schedule. Cruciani--Dudeja study the same loss mechanism but choose uniformly sampled types, with results on hitting times; Anceaume et al. prove Schur optimization for nonexpiring coupons. Long studies stationary entrance flux and deterministic expiration. A full inspected published published-finding corpus record proves majorization for all-at-once catastrophic resets, which has different dynamics and a different event. Neither these inspected statements nor the searched mathematical database subsumes the present independent-loss, time-dependent pair-run theorem. Earlier general dynamic-cache or dynamic-occupancy majorization results could still cover it; no claim of certified uniqueness is made.
residual_risks: An older theorem on dynamic caching, exchangeable occupancy or last-occurrence processes may cover this statement under other terminology.

value.rationale: The probability that all specified items remain simultaneously available at a chosen time is a natural reliability and cache-freshness objective, and heterogeneity in sampling allocation is a controllable design variable. The theorem gives a unique optimal draw allocation for every target set and every sufficiently long finite horizon, surviving arbitrary time variation in a common independent loss schedule; it also solves the natural stationary version. The exact conditional terminal-run identity is a structural mechanism valid beyond a single parameter slice, and evaluating the full 2^n-state distribution is unnecessary. These conclusions are distinct from, and do not claim, a hitting-time ordering. This is not simply the permanent-collection theorem in new names: every type can disappear at every subsequent step.
